recipe.description: Sgt. Hale original anatomical study: restrained rectangular head, narrower face, defined chin projection and cheek ridge, moderate brow and a longer nose profile under the original security cap. Numeric shape controls are graphical inputs only and do not establish age, ethnicity, gender identity or biography. Original seeded skin, hair and wardrobe palettes are retained.

source_indices: All source vertex/UV/face/triangle indices are zero based. Face IDs count every OBJ f line. Triangle IDs count every original face fan triangle, including discarded body regions and helper groups.
lod: Original retained face topology is shared. No simplification or detail-destroying decimation is applied.
